faqs.question: What is an External Workforce Desk and how does Macee manage it?
faqs.answer: An External Workforce Desk acts as your central partner for sourcing, contracting, and managing external talent (contractors, secondment professionals, and interim specialists). Macee takes full responsibility for sourcing, contract administration, compliance audits, and payroll, allowing your internal teams to focus on core operations.

faqs.question: How does Macee guarantee 100% compliance with Dutch labor regulations?
faqs.answer: Macee is SNA NEN 4400-1 certified. We strictly adhere to the Dutch WAADI legislation, DBA regulations (mitigating bogus self-employment / schijnzelfstandigheid), and operate a verified G-account for transparent payroll taxes and social security contributions.

faqs.question: What contract models does Macee offer?
faqs.answer:
We provide flexible contracting options tailored to your project scope:
• Secondment (interim project deployment with full employer liability management)
• Freelance / ZZP brokerage and contract compliance
• Employer of Record (EOR / Legal Employment Services with full local & international compliance)
• Contract-to-Permanent (Deta-Vast) models
• Permanent recruitment and executive search

faqs.question: In which sectors does Macee have proven recruitment expertise?
faqs.answer: MACEE works with clients in various industries, such as Telecoms, FMCG, Oil and Gas, Consultancy, Pharma, Energy/Utilities and many more. MACEE has extensive experience in the finance sector, working with Banks, Investment and Asset Management, Pension funds, Payment Platforms and other Fintech companies.

faqs.question: How quickly can Macee deploy qualified professionals to a project?
faqs.answer: For high-demand roles across IT, Data, Cybersecurity, and Financial Risk, our pre-screened specialist network enables us to introduce verified candidate shortlists within 48 to 72 hours, with rapid contract execution.

faqs.question: What sets Macee apart from traditional recruitment agencies?
faqs.answer: With over 30 years of combined recruitment and contracting experience, Macee operates with a "personal desk" philosophy. We are not a transactional resume shop. We build enduring relationships with senior professionals and enterprise hiring managers, ensuring technical depth, cultural fit, and zero-risk legal frameworks.

faqs.question: Why is the SNA NEN 4400-1 certification critical for our clients?
faqs.answer: NEN 4400-1 certification guarantees that Macee correctly files taxes, pays social security premiums, and verifies the legal right to work in the Netherlands. For our clients, this provides complete indemnity against chain liability (ketenaansprakelijkheid) from the Dutch Tax Administration (Belastingdienst).

faqs.question: Where is Macee located and what areas do you serve?
faqs.answer: Macee is headquartered in Arnhem, Netherlands, and operates nationwide across Amsterdam, Utrecht, Rotterdam, Eindhoven, and cross-border European talent corridors, supplying both on-site and hybrid specialists.

faqs.question: How does the Macee internal team operate?
faqs.answer: Our dedicated team combines specialized technical recruiters, legal compliance officers, and candidate care managers. Every client and candidate has a named single point of contact for contracts, onboarding, timesheets, and invoicing.

faqs.question: How fast can Macee deliver verified candidate profiles?
faqs.answer: For standard high-demand roles (such as Senior Developers, Cloud Architects, or Financial Risk Consultants), we typically present shortlisted, pre-screened candidate profiles within 48 to 72 hours of receiving the briefing.

faqs.question: What guarantee does Macee provide if an interim professional is not the right fit?
faqs.answer: We stand behind our talent with a comprehensive replacement guarantee. During the initial probation or transition window, if a consultant does not meet agreed project benchmarks, we replace the professional swiftly at no additional sourcing charge.

faqs.question: How does Macee protect hiring clients from Wet DBA / False Self-Employment risks?
faqs.answer: We conduct formal contract assessments, use Tax Authority-approved model agreements, monitor operational independence, and offer secondment structures as a compliant alternative whenever ZZP qualification poses regulatory exposure.

faqs.question: Can Macee act as a Master Vendor or Managed Service Provider (MSP)?
faqs.answer: Yes. Macee can consolidate your external contractor desk, streamlining onboarding, rate benchmarking, supplier management, and unified monthly invoicing under a single SLA.

faqs.question: What is your fee structure for interim vs permanent placements?
faqs.answer: For interim and secondment assignments, we operate on transparent, all-inclusive hourly billing with no hidden markups. For permanent recruitment, our competitive fee is milestone-based and only payable upon successful commencement.

faqs.question: What onboarding and relocation support does Macee offer to professionals?
faqs.answer: Macee provides end-to-end guidance for specialists joining Dutch projects, including 30% tax ruling application support, Dutch municipal registration (BSN) guidance, and transparent contract onboarding.

faqs.question: Does Macee support applications for the 30% Tax Ruling (30%-regeling)?
faqs.answer: Yes. If you are recruited from abroad and meet Dutch Tax Authority requirements (specific expertise, minimum salary criteria, and distance conditions), our payroll experts prepare and submit your 30% ruling application directly.

faqs.question: Can my spouse and dependent children move to the Netherlands with me?
faqs.answer: Yes. For international professionals relocating for long-term project engagements, Macee assists with family settling-in guidance, schooling information, and practical local logistics in the Netherlands.

faqs.question: What contract options are available for professionals working through Macee?
faqs.answer:
You can choose the contract model that best fits your situation:
• Secondment employment contract with steady monthly salary, paid holiday allowance, and pension
• Employer of Record (EOR / Legal Employment) with complete immigration & payroll compliance
• Freelance / ZZP broker agreement with swift invoice payment cycles
• Contract-to-perm (Deta-Vast) opportunities with top enterprise employers

faqs.question: How promptly are contractor invoices paid?
faqs.answer: Macee offers fast, reliable payment cycles. Upon timesheet approval, contractor payments are processed within agreed terms, with optional fast-track invoice discounting available.

faqs.question: What format should my CV and portfolio be in when applying?
faqs.answer: We recommend submitting your CV in PDF or DOCX format. Make sure to detail your recent project experience, primary tech stack (programming languages, cloud providers, certifications), and your current availability date.

faqs.question: What happens after I apply for an open project on Macee?
faqs.answer: Your application is immediately routed to our OTYS recruitment system. A specialized recruitment consultant in your domain will review your profile and contact you within 24 to 48 hours for an exploratory conversation and project briefing.

faqs.question: Are remote or hybrid work arrangements available for open assignments?
faqs.answer: The majority of our technology and finance projects offer hybrid working (e.g., 2–3 days remote, 1–2 days on-site at client premises in Amsterdam, Utrecht, Rotterdam, or Eindhoven). Specific remote policies are clearly stated in each project description.

faqs.question: What should I do if there is no open project currently matching my skill set?
faqs.answer: You can submit an Open Application or activate a custom Job Alert on our platform. Whenever a matching assignment is registered by our clients, our system will notify you instantly before public advertisement.

faqs.question: Are all projects published on this website real and currently active?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our job board synchronizes in real time with our live OTYS recruitment desk. Filled or expired roles are unlisted automatically, so every position you view is actively recruiting.

faqs.question: What is the Wet DBA and how does Macee protect clients from enforcement penalties?
faqs.answer: The Wet DBA (Deregulering Beoordeling Arbeidsrelaties) enforces strict boundaries between true self-employment (ZZP) and disguised employment (schijnzelfstandigheid). Macee uses officially verified model agreements, monitors relationship parameters, and provides secondment alternatives to shield clients from retroactive wage taxes and fines.

faqs.question: What is a G-account (G-rekening) and how does it protect hiring companies?
faqs.answer: A G-account is a restricted bank account used solely to pay payroll taxes and VAT to the Dutch Tax Administration. When clients pay the tax portion into Macee’s verified G-account, they are legally indemnified against chain liability under Dutch law.

faqs.question: What is the WAADI legislation and is Macee registered?
faqs.answer: The WAADI (Wet allocatie arbeidskrachten door intermediairs) requires all intermediaries providing personnel in the Netherlands to be formally registered with the Dutch Chamber of Commerce (KvK). Macee is 100% WAADI compliant and registered.

faqs.question: How quickly does Macee respond to website inquiries?
faqs.answer: Our team responds to all form submissions and inquiries within 24 business hours. If your requirement is urgent, you can also call our Arnhem office directly at +31 (0) 26 785 1010.

faqs.question: Can I visit Macee’s Arnhem office for an in-person consultation?
faqs.answer: Yes, we welcome in-person meetings at our Arnhem office (Willemsplein 44, 6811 KD Arnhem). Please schedule an appointment in advance so we can ensure the relevant specialist or account director is available to meet you.

faqs.question: How can an employer request an emergency / urgent interim replacement?
faqs.answer: For critical staffing emergencies (e.g., unexpected departures or urgent regulatory deadlines), indicate "Urgent" in your contact message or call our direct phone line. We can mobilize available bench consultants within 24 to 48 hours.

faqs.question: Are phone consultations free of charge and confidential?
faqs.answer: Yes. All initial consultations, hiring requirement assessments, and candidate career discussions are 100% complimentary and strictly confidential under Dutch privacy and GDPR guidelines.
